verdictReason: All three Phase 6 limitations resolved with executed evidence. Limitation A (no live provider acceptance): root cause proven in production to be the local 40/day Durable Object allowance denying requests before OpenRouter was contacted (providerAttempted=false, aiDailyUsed=40/40), not the provider; allowance raised to 150 on a zero-cost model and three live provider_accepted responses subsequently observed. Limitation B (relationship-blind verification): bounded canonical relationship layer added with explicit denied relations quoted from site data; rejects invented linkages built from individually true nouns. Limitation C (weak taxonomy answers): status and availability semantics made first-class deterministic knowledge. Limitation D (no browser regression proof): 14-case Playwright suite added and proven to fail when the Phase 6 styling fix is reverted.

knownLimitations: Long-form provider synthesis still exceeds the 9s ceiling and falls back gracefully; the timeout was deliberately not raised because buffer-then-validate pays a longer ceiling entirely in visitor wait time.
The daily allowance change (40 -> 150) is a deliberate production config change; zero-cost, but the owner may wish to revisit. Revert by restoring "40" in worker/wrangler.toml.
Upstream OpenRouter free-tier limits remain unmeasured — no upstream 429 has been observed, so the real ceiling above 150 is unknown.
Relationship verification is pattern-based over high-risk linkage verbs between recognised entities; an exotic phrasing or an unrecognised entity can still pass.
Browser suite runs Chromium only, at desktop and 320px, with no visual snapshots — scoped to pinning the two known defects rather than building a visual-testing platform.
pageType is the one context field not regex-shape-validated; it is inert in routing and tested as such.
